name: @eden/lint
description: Shared Biome config, Biome GritQL plugins, anti-slop Oxlint rules, and env-var naming checks for eden projects.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:dist
scripts.test: pnpm test:anti-slop && pnpm test:biome && pnpm test:env
scripts.test:anti-slop: for f in anti-slop/rules/*.test.ts; do tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:dist: pnpm build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard dist)"
